title: SignalStick
description: A 4K digital signage stick and fleet control plane for independent restaurants, coffee shops and bakeries. It pairs a Node.js fleet server with a Linux device agent on each stick, a phone remote for live menu edits and sold-out toggles, and a 4K kiosk player, plus a KiCad board, an OpenSCAD enclosure and a five-venue pilot kit. The repository started as a Google AI Studio hardware workbench; the fleet server, device agent and hardware pack are in an open pull request.
